note: Recorded tool calls that reproduce each <qa_pair> answer in sec.xml, in order. Roles/duties/privileges/entry points only — no user tool is ever called (test/evals-format.test.js enforces it). `expr` is JavaScript over r (structuredContent per call); it must evaluate to the <answer> string.

pairs.title: CustGroupMaintain: its one duty and the roles reaching it
pairs.expr: r[0].parent_duty_count === 1 && !r[1].truncated && r[1].via_chain.every(x => x.duty_id === r[0].parent_duties[0].duty_id) ? r[0].parent_duties[0].duty_id + ',' + r[1].via_chain_count : 'mismatch'

pairs.title: AR manager: privilege granting Delete on CustGroup
pairs.expr: r[0].results.some(x => x.object_name === r[1].role_name) && !r[1].truncated ? [...new Set(r[1].rows.filter(x => x.object_name === 'CustGroup' && x.object_type === 'MenuItemDisplay' && x.grant_delete === 'Allow').map(x => x.priv_name))].join(',') : 'mismatch'

pairs.title: Shared duties: AR manager vs Collections manager
pairs.expr: r[0].results.some(x => x.object_name === r[1].role2) ? r[1].duties_shared_count : 'role not found'

pairs.title: CustCustomerProcessEnable: privilege count and CustGroupMaintain entry points
pairs.expr: r[0].privileges.some(p => p.privilege_name === r[1].privilege_name) ? r[0].privilege_count + ',' + r[1].entry_point_count : 'privilege not in duty'

pairs.title: Accounting manager: Update on CustGroup menu item?
Roles with the duty but without CustGroupView
Collections manager: licence type and stored role_id
Second-largest security model and its *manager* roles
Sales manager on ElectronicMessages: source and Create
pairs.expr: (rows => rows.length > 0 ? [...new Set(rows.map(x => x.source))].join('+') + ',' + (rows.some(x => x.grant_create === 'Allow') ? 'True' : 'False') : 'no rows')(r[1].permissions.filter(x => x.object_name === 'ElectronicMessages' && x.object_type === 'MenuItemDisplay'))
